# SIGMA LMS

> SIGMA LMS is a free online learning platform by SIGMA (LWS): video courses
> with a lesson player, student dashboard, progress tracking and completion
> certificates. Most courses are free; some are paid with coupon/promo codes.

## Key facts

- Website: https://sigmapack4-design.github.io/sigma-lms/
- Sitemap: https://sigmapack4-design.github.io/sigma-lms/sitemap.xml
- Courses: https://sigmapack4-design.github.io/sigma-lms/#/courses
- Community: SIGMA (LWS) WhatsApp channel — free courses, methods and job updates.
